item.title: Gold import jumps: IBJA says investors pumping up demand, jewellery sales dipping
item.description: The rising prices of gold has ensured that investors keep flocking to this asset by droves. IBJA (India Bullion & Jewellers Association) secretary Surendra Mehta thinks the investors, who are trying to capitalise on the boom, are responsible for driving up the demand, not the jewellery sector.

item.title: One gene, many roles: How DNA makes rare diseases look different in every patient
item.description: Advances in DNA sequencing have revealed something surprising—not everyone with the same genetic change develops the same disease, or any disease at all. Some people may develop symptoms early in life, while others remain healthy for decades.

item.title: How can humans work in extreme space environments?
item.description: Scientists from King’s College London and Norwegian New Space Startup Nåva Space have entered into a collaborative agreement. The collaboration will investigate how technologies will help humans operate in extreme space environments.

item.title: No India no problem! On a rainy Wednesday, Delhi turns up in big numbers for neutral T20 World Cup game
item.description: Despite rain threatening the initial start of play and dark clouds hovering over the Arun Jaitley Stadium in New Delhi, fans turned up in big numbers for South Africa’s final group-stage match against UAE in the T20 World Cup 2026.

item.title: Jammu & Kashmir continue dream run to enter maiden Ranji Trophy final
item.description: Abdul Samad’s unbeaten 30 off 27 balls (3×6, 1×4) and Vanshaj Sharma’s 43 not out off 83 ball (4×4) was the cornerstone of their victory at the Bengal Academy Ground as they chased down 126 runs in their second innings.

item.title: India AI Impact Summit 2026: Microsoft unveils $50 Billion AI investment plan for Global South
item.description: At the India AI Impact Summit 2026, Microsoft announced a major $50 billion investment by 2030 to close the AI divide, focusing on countries in the Global South. The plan aims to build AI infrastructure, empower people through skills and technology, strengthen multilingual AI, enable local innovations, and measure AI adoption for targeted interventions.

item.title: Why Indian & global IT giants are witnessing significant stock declines
item.description: The launch of Anthropic’s new AI model has hit the global and Indian IT stocks, including giants like Infosys and Accenture. Investors are concerned and worries about the intensified competition from AI, leading to a market sell-off and causing the Nifty IT index to drop sharply.

item.title: KPMG partner fined $7,000 for using AI to cheat in AI training
item.description: This incident, detected by KPMG’s own AI, reveals a wider struggle with AI-enabled misconduct, with over 24 employees caught this year.

item.title: With US build up consistent, is Israel hinting at a military operation aimed at Iran?
item.description: Iran sees both the US and Israel in combined action against it, be it through supporting its domestic protestors or with possible military action. Recent aggressive rhetoric from both parties against Iran only compounds these fears and chances of direct military confrontation today look not as improbable as earlier assumed.

item.title: Breaking: India AI Impact Summit 2026 extended on public demand
item.description: Good news for AI enthusiasts! The India AI Impact Summit 2026 expo has been extended until February 21st due to high public demand, allowing more visitors to explore. However, please note the expo will be closed on February 19th for a special program and VVIP movement at Bharat Mandapam.
